text((await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import re,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('.ai/task/mechanics-rollback-20261003');c=json.loads((base/'CANDIDATE-RE_REVIEW-1-1.json').read_text());proof=json.loads((base/'PROOF-RE_REVIEW-1-1.json').read_text())
def literal(s,i):
 while s[i].isspace():i+=1
 start=i
 if s[i] in '\"\'':
  q=s[i];i+=1;out=''
  while s[i]!=q:
   if s[i]!='\\':out+=s[i];i+=1;continue
   i+=1
   if s[i].isdigit():
    m=re.match(r'\d{1,3}',s[i:]);out+=chr(int(m[0]));i+=len(m[0])
   else:out+= {'a':'\a','b':'\b','f':'\f','n':'\n','r':'\r','t':'\t','v':'\v','\n':'\n'}.get(s[i],s[i]);i+=1
  return out,start,i+1
 m=re.match(r'\[(=*)\[',s[i:]);assert m;endmark=']'+m[1]+']';a=i+len(m[0]);end=s.index(endmark,a);out=s[a:end]
 if out.startswith('\n'):out=out[1:]
 return out,start,end+len(endmark)
def records(s):
 visible=s
 for m in reversed(list(re.finditer(r'^--\[(=*)\[.*?\]\1\]',s,re.M|re.S))):visible=visible[:m.start()]+' '*len(m[0])+visible[m.end():]
 rows=[]
 for m in re.finditer(r'^(t\(|section\s+)',visible,re.M):
  source,a,b=literal(s,m.end())
  if m[1].startswith('section'):rows.append((source,None,a,b));continue
  i=b
  while s[i].isspace():i+=1
  assert s[i]==','
  target,a,b=literal(s,i+1);rows.append((source,target,a,b))
 return rows
def mask(s,rows):
 for _,tgt,a,b in reversed(rows):
  if tgt is not None:s=s[:a]+'TARGET'+s[b:]
 return s
for fp in proof['files']:
 f=fp['file'];old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',c['pre_repair_commit']+':'+f]).decode();pre=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',c['pre_rollback_commit']+':'+f]).decode();now=Path(f).read_text();rs=[records(s) for s in (old,pre,now)];assert len({len(r) for r in rs})==1
 inv={x['record_index']:x for x in c['items'] if x['file']==f};diff0={i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rs[0],rs[1])) if a[1]!=b[1]};diff1={i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rs[1],rs[2])) if a[1]!=b[1]}
 assert diff0==set(inv),(f,'inventory coverage',diff0^set(inv));assert diff1<=set(inv)
 assert mask(pre,rs[1])==mask(now,rs[2]),(f,'outside targets')
 assert hashlib.sha256(pre.encode()).hexdigest()==fp['baseline_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(now.encode()).hexdigest()==fp['final_sha256'];assert len(rs[2])==fp['record_count'];assert len(diff1)==fp['changed_targets']
 for i,x in inv.items():
  for n,k in enumerate(['baseline_target','pre_rollback_target','final_target']):assert rs[n][i][1]==x[k],(f,i,k)
  assert all(r[i][0]==x['source'] for r in rs),(f,i,'source')
 print(f,'records',len(rs[2]),'inventory',len(inv),'changed',len(diff1),'snapshots and outside-target bytes verified')
print('all 165 snapshot rows verified; no missing inventory or extra target changes')
PY","max_output_tokens":3000})).output);
